request.style: English, soul, female solo voice with gospel choir, upright piano, Hammond organ, double bass, electric guitar, warm and grateful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Give thanks to the Lord today
For he is good and stays
His mercy endures forever
Let the redeemed say so

[Chorus]
Mercy endures forever
Goodness is his name
Praise the Lord for his kindness
We are not the same

[Verse]
He redeemed from the enemy
Gathered out of the lands
From east and from the west
From north and the seas

[Chorus]
Mercy endures forever
Goodness is his name
Praise the Lord for his kindness
We are not the same

[Verse]
Some wandered in the wilderness
A wasteland with no road
Found no city to live in
Lost in the cold

[Chorus]
Mercy endures forever
Goodness is his name
Praise the Lord for his kindness
We are not the same

[Outro]
His mercy endures forever
